card.title: Happy Birthday!
card.text: Wishing you a wonderful new year filled with health, joy, and everything you desire.

card.title: A Lifetime of Happiness
card.text: Wishing you both everlasting love, unity, and complete happiness together.

card.title: To My Beloved
card.text: Thank you for being by my side. Wishing us everlasting love and happiness.

card.title: Merry Christmas
card.text: Wishing you a warm, peaceful Christmas filled with love and joy.

card.title: Happy New Year!
card.text: Wishing you a new year full of peace, good fortune, success, and positive energy!

card.title: Congratulations!
card.text: Congratulations on your amazing achievement — all your hard work has truly paid off!

card.title: Happy Grand Opening!
card.text: Wishing you a prosperous grand opening, smooth business, and a flood of customers!

card.title: Thank You So Much
card.text: Thank you for your trust and companionship. With heartfelt appreciation!

card.title: Happy Housewarming!
card.text: Wishing your new home brings you peace, warmth, happiness, and good fortune.

card.title: Happy Halloween!
card.text: Wishing you a fun, cool, and thrilling Halloween night full of surprises!

card.title: Happy Mid-Autumn Festival
card.text: Wishing you a warm reunion, bright moonlight, and complete happiness.

card.title: Happy Anniversary!
card.text: Wishing you both a lasting bond and ever-growing happiness together.

card.title: Happy Lunar New Year!
card.text: Wishing you prosperity, good fortune, and a home filled with blessings.

card.title: Happy Women's Day!
card.text: Wishing you beauty, confidence, happiness, and love every single day.

card.title: Thank You, Dear Teacher
card.text: Thank you for your dedication and guidance. Wishing you good health and happiness always.
